data.title: Fun Word Reading Practice
data.description: You will look at short printed words and say them out loud.
data.gradeLevel: kindergarten students (ages 5-6) - Use clear language, relatable examples, foundational skills, and engaging visuals. Encourage exploration and basic problem-solving.

items.ask: Look at this printed word. What word?
items.howToPlay: I will show you a word, and you read it out loud.
items.acceptRule: Sounding out the letters individually and then blending them together to say the full word counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Stating just a random letter sound from the word instead of blending them is not the full word.
items.correctionBody: The word is cat. Sound it out: c-a-t, cat.

actionContract.label: Read It Aloud
actionContract.instruction: Look at this printed word. What word?

items.ask: Here is the next one. What word?
items.howToPlay: I will show you a word, and you read it out loud.
items.acceptRule: Sounding out the letters individually and then blending them together to say the full word counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Saying a completely different animal name that starts with the same letter is not the printed word.
items.correctionBody: This word is dog. We blend the sounds together to read dog.

actionContract.label: Read It Aloud
actionContract.instruction: Here is the next one. What word?

items.ask: Keep going, you are doing great. What word?
items.howToPlay: I will show you a word, and you read it out loud.
items.acceptRule: Sounding out the letters individually and then blending them together to say the full word counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Naming a related weather word like hot instead of reading the actual letters printed is not the answer.
items.correctionBody: The word is sun. Blend the sounds: s-u-n, sun.

actionContract.label: Read It Aloud
actionContract.instruction: Keep going, you are doing great. What word?

items.ask: Last one, read it loud and clear. What word?
items.howToPlay: I will show you a word, and you read it out loud.
items.acceptRule: Sounding out the letters individually and then blending them together to say the full word counts as the correct answer.
items.signatureError: Repeating the tutor's question words back instead of reading the printed text is not the answer.
items.correctionBody: This word is hop. Hear the sounds: h-o-p, hop.

actionContract.label: Read It Aloud
actionContract.instruction: Last one, read it loud and clear. What word?
